description: This file defines the PersistentStreamPullingManager class, which manages stream pulling agents for persistent streams within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It handles queue distribution, agent lifecycle management, and coordination with queue balancers and filters.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing persistent stream pulling agents, handling queue assignments, agent lifecycle, and reacting to queue distribution changes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the pulling manager, setting up the queue balancer, timers, and internal state.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops all agents, timers, and the queue balancer.

methods.name: StartAgents
methods.description: Starts stream pulling agents based on current queue assignments.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notification when the queue distribution changes, scheduling the rebalancing of queues.

methods.name: HandleQueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Processes a queue distribution change notification, ensuring serial execution.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Performs reallocation of queues based on the latest queue balancer state.

methods.name: AddNewQueues
methods.description: Creates and initializes new pulling agents for newly assigned queues.

methods.name: RemoveQueues
methods.description: Removes agents and responsibilities for queues no longer assigned.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes commands like start or stop agents, and retrieves state information.

methods.name: QueueCommandForExecution
methods.description: Serializes command execution to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: AsyncTimerCallback
methods.description: Periodic callback to log current queue responsibilities.
